quote: What we're talking about here are performance standards, plain and simple.
chinese: 这就是教师绩效标准，简单明了。
speaker_scene: Frank; education working group; standards negotiation
reason: Precise clarification followed by a reusable plain-speaking close.

quote: There's no harm in hearing them out, right?
chinese: 听他们说完也没坏处，对吧？
reason: Softens a disagreement and opens room for another side.

quote: Veteran teachers would have to be exempt if they have a proven record of excellence with the students.
chinese: 如果资深教师教学成绩斐然，他们就可以免考。
speaker_scene: Frank; education working group; policy condition
reason: Complete conditional policy language with a useful qualification frame.

quote: Corey, will you take the reins on this?
chinese: 科瑞，你来负责这件事好吗？
reason: Clean delegation using a common leadership idiom.

quote: It's worth throwing Gaffney under the bus to drag you into the mess.
chinese: 为了把你拖下水，牺牲加夫尼也值得。
reason: Memorable idiom, but the political manipulation is scene-specific and recognition-only.

quote: Let him make a fool out of himself.
chinese: 让他自己出丑吧。
reason: Short, natural permission-to-wait line that transfers directly to everyday situations.

quote: And you will be the butt of it.
chinese: 到时候你就成笑柄了。
reason: Useful idiom with a sharp comic edge; keep the surrounding reply for meaning.

quote: Phone call's not going to cut it.
chinese: 打电话是不够的。
reason: Highly reusable way to say that a remote or minimal response is insufficient.

quote: We get on this thing right now, we can contain it. We wait until Monday, then there's no way to know how much this is going to blow up on us.
chinese: 我们现在马上处理这件事，还能控制住。等到周一，就不知道它会闹到多大了。
reason: Complete cause-and-effect mini-brief with two transferable urgency frames.

quote: The first hundred days is almost over. If we push back the speech, it'll look like we're spinning our wheels.
chinese: 就职百天转眼就要到了。如果我们推迟演说，会让人觉得我们一直在原地打转。
reason: Explains deadline pressure and the reputational cost of delay in natural workplace language.

quote: Anything big comes up, I'm a phone call away.
chinese: 有什么要紧事，打电话就行了。
reason: Compact reassurance and availability frame for work or personal coordination.

quote: Now, Marty, cut me a little slack here.
chinese: 马蒂，这次就放我一马吧。
reason: Natural request for leniency that works beyond the political scene.

quote: We're not here to talk about photography. Are we?
chinese: 我们也不是来谈摄影的，对吗？
speaker_scene: Claire; Gillian meeting; redirect from small talk
reason: Polite but firm redirection from surface talk to the real agenda.

quote: You run into any trouble, you call me. I got it covered.
chinese: 遇到任何麻烦，打电话给我。我来搞定。
reason: Two natural support lines with a clear if-problem-then-contact pattern.

quote: Which do you want, my source or my integrity?
chinese: 您想要什么，我的消息来源，还是我的气节？
reason: Memorable ethical boundary that turns a demand into a crisp either-or question.

quote: I've worked really hard to gain a foothold with World Well.
chinese: 为了让世界之井站稳脚跟，我付出了很大努力。
reason: Useful achievement narrative with the transferable idiom gain a foothold.

quote: And I had to juggle two temp jobs just to pay the rent.
chinese: 我还得同时做两份临时工作，才能付得起房租。
reason: Natural description of balancing work under financial pressure.

quote: All I want is for you to grow what you've already built.
chinese: 我只希望你把亲手建立的事业发展壮大。
reason: Direct encouragement using a reusable all-I-want-is-for-you-to frame.

quote: We don't have to jump into anything.
chinese: 我们不必操之过急。
speaker_scene: Claire; Gillian recruitment; pacing a decision
reason: Calmly removes pressure while leaving the decision open.

quote: I grew up here, in the up country-- Bibles, barbecues, and broken backs. Everything gets just a little bit thicker this far south. The air, the blood, even me. I try to make it down here at least once a month. Every trip is a reminder of how far I've come. I hated Gaffney as a kid, when I had nothing, but now I've come to appreciate it. It's not as suffocating as it once was, except when I have to deal with the sort of nonsense that makes me want to hang myself.
chinese: 我在这个小乡村长大——《圣经》、烧烤，还有沉重的负担。越往南，一切都显得更加浓郁：空气、血液，甚至我自己。我尽量每个月至少来一次。每次来都会提醒我已经走了多远。小时候我讨厌加夫尼，那时我一无所有；但现在我开始欣赏这里。它不像从前那样令人窒息了，除非我得处理那些让我想上吊的屁事。
speaker_scene: Frank; Gaffney visit; direct-address personal reflection
reason: Complete place-memory and personal-change arc; elegant narration is worth preserving, while the dark ending keeps it out of daily imitation.

quote: As a private citizen, well, it looks like the sun is shining where it shouldn't be.
chinese: 作为普通公民嘛，看起来就像阳光照到了不该照到的地方。
reason: Sharp double entendre and character voice; keep for recognition, not imitation.

quote: I'm not trying to start an argument here.
chinese: 我不是来吵架的。
reason: Useful softener before a difficult point or disagreement.

quote: It's not a deal. It's an opportunity.
chinese: 这不是交易，这是机遇。
reason: Compact contrast that reframes a proposal without adding extra explanation.

quote: The criteria is a starting point. They're suggested, not mandated.
chinese: 考核标准是出发点，只是建议，不是强制要求。
speaker_scene: Frank; education working group; policy negotiation
reason: Complete framing for a proposal that leaves room for revision.

quote: Let's not jump to ultimatums.
chinese: 我们别急着下最后通牒。
speaker_scene: Frank; education working group; conflict management
reason: Highly reusable way to slow a negotiation before it hardens.

quote: We can't move forward without addressing this point.
chinese: 不把这件事说清楚，我们没法继续。
reason: Directly states a prerequisite for progress without becoming confrontational.

quote: When Orrin gets a jury to weep a river of snot over this dead girl, when Gaffney goes tits up because you can't afford to pay a seven-figure award in damages, when you all get booted out of office and I lose to Chase, then you can chew my ear off about principles, because we'll all have nothing but time on our hands.
chinese: 等奥林找来陪审团为这女孩挥泪如雨，等加夫尼因为付不起上百万的赔偿而破产，等你们都被一脚踹出办公室，而我也输给蔡斯，那时你再来跟我唠叨你的原则，因为到时我们唯一不缺的就是时间。
reason: Complete rhythmic conditional chain; memorable rhetoric, but slang and political stakes make it recognition-first.

quote: I won't fight you on this, not if this is what you feel you need to do.
chinese: 只要这是你觉得自己需要做的事，我就不会反对你。
reason: Complete support sentence for acknowledging another person's need without surrendering honesty.

quote: Here's what I think. I wish I could be bigger than this, but I can't, and I'm being selfish, and I realize it's mostly about me, but fuck it. I have to say it. Please don't take that other job, Christina.
chinese: 我是这么想的。我希望自己能更大度一些，但我做不到；我这样很自私，也知道这主要是关于我自己，但管它呢。我必须说出来：克里斯蒂娜，请不要接受那份工作。
reason: A complete vulnerable confession with a clear admission → qualification → request arc; profanity and scene specificity make it B-Classic.

quote: I wouldn't argue with that statement. We could do more.
chinese: 我不会反驳这一观点。我们可以做得更多。
reason: Useful concession followed by a constructive next step.

quote: You know what no one wants to talk about? Hate. I know all about hate. It starts in your gut, deep down here, where it stirs and churns. And then it rises. Hate rises fast and volcanic. It erupts hot on the breath. Your eyes go wide with fire. You clench your teeth so hard you think they'll shatter. I hate you, God. I hate you!
chinese: 有一个话题人人回避。恨。我非常了解恨。它在你的腹中、在身体深处酝酿，搅动翻腾。接着它涌起，猛烈得像火山喷发。它炽热地冲上呼吸。你的双眼因怒火睁大；你咬紧牙关，简直要把牙齿咬碎。我恨你，上帝。我恨你！
reason: A complete sensory escalation and memorable rhetoric; religious anger and violent imagery make it recognition-only.

quote: Truth be told, I never really knew him or what his dreams were. He was quiet, timid, almost invisible. My mother didn't think much of him. My mother's mother hated him. The man never scratched the surface of life. Maybe it's best he died so young. He wasn't doing much but taking up space. But that doesn't make for a very powerful eulogy, now, does it?
chinese: 事实是，我从来没有真正了解过他，也不知道他的梦想。他安静、胆小，几乎没有存在感。我母亲不怎么看得起他。我外祖母讨厌他。这个人从未真正触及生活的表面。也许他英年早逝反而更好。他没做什么，只是在占地方。但这算不上什么有力量的悼词，对吧？
speaker_scene: Frank; church sermon; confirmed direct-address aside
reason: Confirmed complete aside with unusually precise contrast and a strong closing tag question; preserve for close listening, not daily imitation.

quote: Your job is to report the news, not be the news.
chinese: 你的工作是报道新闻，不是成为新闻。
reason: Memorable parallel contrast that transfers cleanly to work and media contexts.

quote: I'm doing the best I can, but I can't be in two places at once.
chinese: 我在尽我所能，但我不可能同时出现在两个地方。
reason: Highly reusable way to acknowledge effort while naming a real capacity limit.

quote: I want to enable you. I want to clear the way for you so that you can achieve what you want to achieve, on your own terms.
chinese: 我想给你施展的平台，帮你扫除障碍，让你按自己的方式实现想实现的目标。
reason: Excellent autonomy-preserving support language with a complete purpose chain.

quote: But, most importantly, we have to make sure that this never happens again.
chinese: 但最重要的是，我们必须确保这种事再也不会发生。
reason: Strong priority marker followed by a concrete prevention commitment.

quote: What else can we do but take what seems meaningless and try to make something meaningful from it?
chinese: 除了从看似毫无意义的事中尽力挖掘出一些有意义的东西，我们还能做什么呢？
speaker_scene: Frank; Masters family; meaning after loss
reason: Complete reflective question with a powerful meaning-making structure.

quote: What you have to understand about my people is that they are a noble people. Humility is their form of pride. It is their strength, it is their weakness, and if you can humble yourself before them, they will do anything you ask.
chinese: 你要明白，我的乡亲们是高尚的人。谦逊是他们自豪的形式；这是他们的力量，也是他们的弱点。如果你能在他们面前保持谦卑，他们会为你做任何事。
speaker_scene: Frank; Masters family; confirmed direct-address aside
reason: Confirmed aside with elegant parallel structure, but its instrumental view of a community makes it recognition-first.

quote: But I'll tell you what. I'm not a vindictive person. I don't like for anybody to lose if everybody can win, so I'm going to help you get elected in the fourth. You get to keep your house. I keep the fifth. We put the Peachoid behind us, and everybody's happy.
chinese: 不过我告诉你，我不是个喜欢报复的人。如果能共赢，我不愿看到任何人输；所以我会帮你赢得第四选区。你保住房子，我保住第五选区。我们把大桃子抛到脑后，皆大欢喜。
reason: Complete bargain speech with a clear if-everybody-can-win frame; political coercion keeps it recognition-only.

quote: You don't want to work anywhere you're not willing to get fired from, Zoe. Treading water's the same as drowning for people like you and me.
chinese: 你不该在一个自己不愿意被解雇的地方工作。对你我这样的人来说，勉强维持现状就等于溺水。
reason: Two connected complete metaphors turn career advice into a memorable decision rule.
